kernels.definition: A beat is a regularly recurring pulse, and meter organizes recurring beats into groups while rhythm places durations and attacks within that framework.

definitionAnchor.quote: A beat is a pulse in music that regularly recurs.

facts.text: Duple meter groups beats in twos, triple meter groups them in threes, and quadruple meter groups them in fours.

anchor.quote: Duple meters have groupings of two beats, triple meters have groupings of three beats, and quadruple meters have groupings of four beats.

facts.text: In simple meter, each beat divides into two equal parts; in compound meter, each beat divides into three equal parts.

anchor.quote: Compound meters are meters in which the beat divides into three.

facts.text: In a simple-meter time signature, the top number gives the beats per measure and the bottom number identifies the note value used as the beat unit.

anchor.quote: the top number of a time signature represents the number of beats in each measure, while the bottom number represents the beat unit

facts.text: A measure contains one recurring beat group, and bar lines separate adjacent measures in notation.

anchor.quote: A measure is equivalent to one group of beats.

mcItems.q: When analyzing a simple-meter time signature, what does the top number represent?
op: The number of equal parts that make up each beat
The total number of beats in the measure
The note value used as the beat unit
The number of recurring beat groups in the measure
mcItems.ex: The top number represents the total number of beats in the measure because the top number in a simple-meter time signature gives the beats per measure.

mcItems.q: In a compound meter, how is each beat divided?
op: Into two equal parts
Into three equal parts
Into four equal parts
Into one equal part
mcItems.ex: Each beat in compound meter divides into three equal parts because in simple meter, each beat divides into two equal parts, and compound meter is the opposite.

keyTerms.cx: A recurring pulse is the regularly recurring pulse that organizes the structure of music.

keyTerms.df: A measure is the unit in notation that contains one recurring beat group.
keyTerms.eg: A measure contains one recurring beat group because a measure contains one recurring beat group.
keyTerms.mi: A measure is the division of time between two adjacent beats.
keyTerms.cx: A measure is the unit in notation that contains one recurring beat group.
